title: Should ChatGPT Write Your Breakup Text? Exploring User Needs and Perception of AI’s Role in Ending Relationships

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative thematic analysis of semi-structured user interviews assessing participants' concerns that AI systems generate Western-centric responses and lack the cultural nuance necessary for sensitive relationship advice.

Qualitative evaluation through semi-structured interviews where users expressed skepticism that AI training data adequately reflects the lived experiences and relationship dynamics of people of color.
